In a collision-avoidance encounter: I have just completed this step: as stand-on vessel, take action by maneuver alone as soon as it becomes apparent the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action. What is the next step?

This matters because rule 17(b) requires the stand-on vessel to act decisively when collision becomes imminent regardless of right-of-way status. Be careful: being the stand-on vessel does not confer an absolute right of way.
